title: A balance equal to the limit does not warn, one cent over does
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Two Net 30 customers with $500 limits: one owes exactly $500 and the other one cent more.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds Net 30 with a credit limit of $500.00 and unpaid invoices totalling exactly $500.00; customer {Customer-B} holds Net 30 with a $500.00 limit and unpaid invoices totalling $500.01.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S9-10 Customer and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S9-10 One Cent.
  • Starting screen: the Work Orders page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Work Order".
  2. Pick {Customer-A} as the customer.
  3. Confirm the New Work Order window with its create button.
  4. Click "New Work Order".
  5. Pick {Customer-B} as the customer.
  6. Confirm the New Work Order window with its create button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the New Work Order window opens.
  • Step 2: the window shows {Customer-A} as the customer.
  • Step 3: no over-credit confirmation opens; the New Work Order goes straight on as for any customer. ($500.00 does not exceed $500.00.)
  • Step 4: the New Work Order window opens.
  • Step 5: the window shows the picked customer.
  • Step 6: a confirmation opens titled "Confirmation" with the message "Are you sure you want to open a new work order? This customer is over their credit limit." and the buttons "Create" and "Cancel", worded exactly as before the release. ($500.01 exceeds $500.00 by one cent.)

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning)

  • S9-R1: “When a user opens a new work order for a customer whose balance exceeds a credit limit above $0, and the customer is not on COD, Due on Receipt or Credit Hold, the existing confirmation shows unchanged: title "Confirmation", message "Are you sure you want to open a new work order? This customer is over their credit limit.", buttons "Create" and "Cancel".”
